HomePage.introTitle: Mātaki Tautangata i ngā Stories me ngā Kōtaha Whānui a Instagram
HomePage.introText1: He Kaimātaki Story Instagram kore utu a InstaView Stories e āwhina ana i a koe ki te torotoro i ngā ihirangi Instagram e wātea ana, kaua e takiuru. Whakauruhia te ingoa kaiwhakamahi Instagram, te hononga kōtaha rānei kia mātaki ai i ngā Stories e wātea ana, kia tirotiro ai i ngā pārongo kōtaha, kia torotoro ai hoki i ngā whakaahua, ngā ataata, ngā Reels, me ngā Highlights Story a Instagram.
HomePage.introText2: Ka taea hoki e koe te whakamahi i a InstaView Stories ki te kimi pānui, ki te mātaki whakaahua kōtaha, me te uru ki ētahi ihirangi motuhake mā te whakauru i tētahi hononga pānui, Reel rānei a Instagram e tautokona ana, ā, ka tikiakehia mā te pāwhiri kotahi i runga i tētahi pūrere. I hangaia tēnei taputapu kia ngāwari, kia mārie hoki te tirotiro, kāore he rēhitatanga, kupuhipa Instagram, pārongo whaiaro rānei e hiahiatia ana.
HomePage.introText3: Ahakoa e hiahia ana koe ki te mātaki tautangata i ngā Stories a Instagram, ki te torotoro i tētahi kōtaha kaiwhakamahi, ki te tirotiro i ngā Highlights a Instagram, ki te kimi rānei i tētahi whakaahua, ataata, Reel rānei, ka whakakotahihia e InstaView Stories ēnei āhuatanga ki roto i tētahi Kaimātaki Kōtaha me te Kaimātaki Story a Instagram ngāwari ki te whakamahi.
HomePage.featuresTitle: Ngā Āhuatanga o te Kaimātaki Story Instagram
HomePage.featuresIntro: Torotorohia ngā ihirangi Instagram e wātea ana ki te marea mā InstaView Stories. Mātakihia ngā Stories, kōtaha, pānui, Highlights, whakaahua, ataata, me ngā Reels whānui mā tētahi taputapu ngāwari, māmā hoki ki te whakamahi.
HomePage.featureCard1Text: Whakauruhia he ingoa kaiwhakamahi Instagram whānui, he hononga kōtaha rānei kia torotoro ai i ngā Stories Instagram e wātea ana. Mā tā mātou Kaimātaki Story Instagram kore utu e māmā ake te kite i ngā ihirangi Story whānui, kaua e takiuru.
HomePage.featureCard2Text: Mātakihia ngā pārongo kōtaha whānui e wātea ana, tae atu ki te whakamārama, ngā kaiwhai, ngā mea e whāia ana, ngā pānui, me ngā taipitopito tohu whakamana. Whakamahia a InstaView Stories hei Kaimātaki Kōtaha Instagram ngāwari kia torotoro ai i ngā pūkete whānui i te wāhi kotahi.
HomePage.featureCard3Text: Torotorohia ngā whakaahua me ngā ataata i tohaina e ngā kōtaha Instagram whānui. Tirotirohia ngā pānui Instagram e wātea ana mā roto i tētahi atanga mā, ngāwari hoki, kaua e whakaterehia mā roto i tētahi whakatakotoranga uaua.
HomePage.featureCard4Text: Torotorohia ngā Highlights Story Instagram e wātea ana mai i ngā kōtaha whānui. Mā tā mātou Kaimātaki Highlights Instagram koe e āwhina ki te kite i ngā Stories kua tiakina, ki te tirotiro hoki i ngā ihirangi Highlight whānui i te wāhi kotahi.
HomePage.featureCard5Text: Tiakina ngā whakaahua me ngā ataata Story Instagram whānui e wātea ana ina tautokona te kōwhiringa tikiake. Mā te Kaitikiake Story Instagram e whakarato tētahi huarahi māmā ki te uru atu ki ngā ihirangi Story e tautokona ana.
HomePage.featureCard6Text: Tikiakehia ngā Highlights Instagram whānui e wātea ana ina tautokona. Whakamahia te Kaitikiake Highlights Instagram ki te tiaki i ngā whakaahua me ngā ataata Highlight e tautokona ana hei mātaki ā muri ake.
HomePage.featureCard7Text: Mātakihia, tiakina hoki ngā whakaahua e wātea ana mai i ngā pānui Instagram whānui. Mā tā mātou Kaitikiake Whakaahua Instagram e whakarato tētahi kōwhiringa tikiake ngāwari mō ngā ihirangi whakaahua whānui e tautokona ana.
HomePage.featureCard8Text: Urua ngā ataata e wātea ana mai i ngā pānui me ngā kōtaha Instagram whānui. Tikiakehia ngā ataata Instagram whānui e tautokona ana mā roto i tētahi tukanga ngāwari, māmā hoki.
HomePage.featureCard9Text: Torotorohia, tikiakehia hoki ngā Reels Instagram whānui e wātea ana ina tautokona. Mā te Kaitikiake Reels Instagram e whakamāmā ake te uru atu ki ngā ataata Reel e tautokona ana mai i ngā kōtaha whānui, i ngā hononga pānui tika rānei.
HomePage.featureCard10Text: Mātakihia ngā whakaahua kōtaha e wātea ana mai i ngā pūkete Instagram whānui, ka tikiakehia ina tautokona. Mā te Kaitikiake Whakaahua Kōtaha Instagram e whakarato tētahi huarahi ngāwari ki te uru atu ki ngā whakaahua kōtaha whānui.
HomePage.featuresClosing: Ka mahi ngā āhuatanga katoa ki ngā ihirangi Instagram e wātea ana anake. Kāore he takiuru Instagram, rēhitatanga, kupuhipa, pārongo whaiaro rānei e hiahiatia ana.
HomePage.howItWorksTitle: Me Pēhea te Mahi a InstaView Stories
HomePage.howItWorksIntro: Torotorohia ngā Stories, kōtaha, pānui, Highlights, whakaahua, ataata, me ngā Reels a Instagram whānui i roto i ngā kaupae ngāwari e toru.
HomePage.step1Title: Whakauruhia he Ingoa Kaiwhakamahi, he Hononga rānei
HomePage.step1Text: Whakauruhia he ingoa kaiwhakamahi Instagram whānui, he hononga kōtaha, he URL pānui, Reel rānei a Instagram e tautokona ana ki te pae rapu.
HomePage.step2Title: Torotoro i ngā Ihirangi Instagram Whānui
HomePage.step2Text: Pāwhiritia Mātaki i ngā Stories kia uru atu ai ki ngā Stories whānui e wātea ana, ngā pārongo kōtaha, ngā pānui, ngā whakaahua, ngā ataata, ngā Reels, me ngā Highlights Story a Instagram.
HomePage.step3Title: Mātaki, Tikiake Rānei i ngā Ihirangi
HomePage.step3Text: Tīpakohia te ihirangi e hiahia ana koe ki te torotoro. Ina tautokona, ka taea e koe te tikiake i ngā Stories, Highlights, whakaahua, ataata, Reels, me ngā whakaahua kōtaha whānui e wātea ana.
HomePage.howItWorksCta: Tīmatahia te torotoro i ngā ihirangi Instagram whānui mā InstaView Stories — kāore he rēhitatanga, takiuru Instagram rānei e hiahiatia ana.
HomePage.whyTitle: He Aha koe e Kōwhiri ai i a InstaView Stories?
HomePage.whyText: Mā InstaView Stories e whakarato tētahi huarahi ngāwari, whai hua hoki ki te torotoro i ngā ihirangi Instagram e wātea ana ki te marea, kaua e whai i ngā kaupae kore take.
HomePage.whyItem1Title: Kāore he Takiuru Instagram e Hiahiatia ana
HomePage.whyItem1Text: Torotorohia ngā Stories, kōtaha, pānui, me ngā Reels a Instagram whānui, kaua e whakauru i tō ingoa kaiwhakamahi, kupuhipa, taipitopito takiuru rānei Instagram.
HomePage.whyItem2Text: Mātakihia ngā ihirangi Instagram whānui e wātea ana (pēnei i ngā Stories, Highlights, whakaahua, ataata, Reels, pārongo kōtaha, me ngā whakaahua kōtaha) kaua e tōtika te whakawhitiwhiti ki te kōtaha. Ko ngā ihirangi e wātea whānui ana anake e tautokona ana.
HomePage.whyItem3Title: Tere me te Māmā ki te Whakamahi
HomePage.whyItem3Text: Whakauruhia he ingoa kaiwhakamahi, he hononga Instagram e tautokona ana rānei, kia uru atu ai ki ngā ihirangi e wātea ana mā roto i tētahi atanga ngāwari, māmā hoki ki te whakamahi.
HomePage.whyItem4Title: He Wheako Pai mō ngā Pūrere Pūkoro
HomePage.whyItem4Text: Whakamahia a InstaView Stories i runga i ngā waea atamai, papatuhi, rorohiko waewae, me ngā rorohiko pākiaka, kaua e whakauru i ētahi atu pūmanawa.
HomePage.whyItem5Text: Torotorohia ngā Stories, Highlights, whakaahua, ataata, Reels, pārongo kōtaha, me ngā whakaahua kōtaha whānui, mā te taputapu kotahi.
HomePage.whyItem6Title: Ngā Kōwhiringa Tikiake e Tautokona ana
HomePage.whyItem6Text: Tikiakehia ngā Stories, Highlights, whakaahua, ataata, Reels, me ngā whakaahua kōtaha whānui e wātea ana, ina tautokona te āhuatanga tikiake.
HomePage.whyItem7Title: Uru Mai i Ngā Wāhi Katoa
HomePage.whyItem7Text: Whakamahia a InstaView Stories mai i ngā wāhi katoa he hononga ipurangi. I hangaia te taputapu mō ngā kaiwhakamahi e torotoro ana i ngā ihirangi Instagram whānui puta noa i te ao.
HomePage.whyItem8Title: He Wheako e Arotahi ana ki te Tūmataiti
HomePage.whyItem8Text: Kāore he kupuhipa Instagram, rēhitatanga pūkete, pārongo whaiaro kore take rānei e hiahiatia ana ki te whakamahi i te taputapu.
HomePage.whyItem9Text: Ngākau nui ki te mātaki Instagram whānui mutunga kore, kāore he ohaurunga, utu, utu huna rānei.
HomePage.whyNote: Ko ngā ihirangi Instagram e wātea ana ki te marea anake e tautokona ana e InstaView Stories. Kāore e taea te uru atu ki ngā pūkete tūmataiti me ngā ihirangi here.
HomePage.doItem1: Tikina he whārangi kōtaha whānui, pēnei i tā tētahi kaitirotiro tautangata
HomePage.doItem2: Whakaaturia ngā pārongo whānui katoa e whakaurua ana e Instagram ki taua whārangi
HomePage.doItem3: Kāore he mea kē atu: kāore he tirotiro rārangi kōrero, kāore he karere, kāore he whakahaere pūkete
HomePage.whatWeDontTitle: Ngā Mea Kāore Mātou e Mahi
HomePage.dontItem1: E kore rawa mātou e tono i tō kupuhipa Instagram, i ō taipitopito takiuru rānei
HomePage.dontItem2: E kore rawa mātou e uru atu ki ngā pūkete tūmataiti, e karo rānei i ngā tautuhinga tūmataiti
HomePage.dontItem3: E kore rawa e hiahiatia he pūkete kia whakamahia ai te taputapu
HomePage.aboutFooterText: He motuhake a {siteName}, kāore i te piri ki a, i te tautokona e, i te hono rānei ki a Instagram, ki a Meta Platforms, Inc. rānei. Pānuitia te <aboutLink>whārangi Mō Mātou</aboutLink> katoa, te <privacyLink>Kaupapa Here Tūmataiti</privacyLink> rānei.
HomePage.contactText: He pātai, he urupare, he tono rānei e pā ana ki ngā ihirangi e whakaaturia whānuitia ana: whakapā mai, ā, ka whakahoki mātou i tō karere.
HomePage.faqIntro: Ngā whakautu ki ngā pātai auau e pā ana ki te mātaki me te tikiake i ngā Stories, kōtaha, pānui, Highlights, me ngā Reels a Instagram whānui mā InstaView Stories.
HomePage.faq1A: He Kaimātaki Story Instagram ā-ipurangi a InstaView Stories e taea ai e koe te torotoro i ngā Stories, kōtaha, pānui, Highlights, whakaahua, ataata, me ngā Reels a Instagram e wātea whānuitia ana, mā te taputapu ngāwari kotahi.
HomePage.faq2Q: Ka taea e au te mātaki i ngā Stories Instagram kaua e takiuru?
HomePage.faq2A: Āe. Ka taea e koe te torotoro i ngā Stories Instagram whānui e wātea ana, kaua e takiuru ki a Instagram, kaua rānei e homai i tō kupuhipa Instagram.
HomePage.faq3Q: Ka taea e au te mātaki tautangata i ngā Stories Instagram?
HomePage.faq3A: Ka taea e koe te mātaki i ngā Stories Instagram whānui e wātea ana, kaua e tōtika te whakawhitiwhiti ki te kōtaha Instagram. Kāore a InstaView Stories e tautoko i ngā ihirangi tūmataiti, here rānei.
HomePage.faq4Q: He kore utu te whakamahi i a InstaView Stories?
HomePage.faq4A: Āe. I hangaia a InstaView Stories kia whakarato i te urunga kore utu ki ngā ihirangi Instagram whānui e tautokona ana. Ko ētahi āhuatanga ka whakawhirinaki pea ki te wātea o te ihirangi me te tautoko hangarau.
HomePage.faq5Q: Ka taea e au te mātaki i ngā pūkete Instagram tūmataiti?
HomePage.faq5A: Kāo. Ko ngā ihirangi Instagram e wātea whānuitia ana anake e tautokona ana e InstaView Stories. Kāore e taea te uru atu ki ngā pūkete tūmataiti me ngā Stories here.
HomePage.faq6Q: Ka taea e au te whakamahi i tētahi hononga kōtaha Instagram?
HomePage.faq6A: Āe. Ka taea e koe te whakauru i tētahi ingoa kaiwhakamahi, hononga kōtaha rānei Instagram whānui kia torotoro ai i ngā Stories, ngā pārongo kōtaha, ngā pānui, me ngā Highlights e wātea ana.
HomePage.faq7Q: Ka taea e au te mātaki i ngā Highlights Instagram?
HomePage.faq7A: Āe. Ka taea e koe te torotoro i ngā Highlights Story Instagram whānui e wātea ana mā te Kaimātaki Highlights Instagram. Ka wātea te tikiake i ngā Highlights ina tautokona anake.
HomePage.faq8Q: Ka taea e au te tikiake i ngā Stories me ngā Reels Instagram?
HomePage.faq8A: Ka taea e koe te tikiake i ngā Stories, whakaahua, ataata, Highlights, me ngā Reels whānui e wātea ana, ina tautokona te kōwhiringa tikiake mō taua ihirangi.
HomePage.faq9A: Kāo. Kāore koe e hiahia ana ki tētahi pūkete Instagram, rēhitatanga, takiuru Instagram rānei ki te whakamahi i a InstaView Stories.
HomePage.faq10Q: Kei te wātea a InstaView Stories i runga i ngā pūrere pūkoro?
HomePage.faq10A: Āe. Ka taea te whakamahi i a InstaView Stories i runga i ngā waea atamai, papatuhi, rorohiko waewae, me ngā rorohiko pākiaka mā roto i tētahi kaitirotiro paetukutuku.
HomePage.faq11Q: He aha ētahi ihirangi Instagram i te kore e wātea?
HomePage.faq11A: Kāore pea he ihirangi e wātea nā te mea he tūmataiti te kōtaha, kua pau te wā o te Story, kua tangohia te ihirangi, kua herea hangarautia rānei te urunga ki a Instagram.
HomePage.faq12Q: E hiahiatia ana tōku kupuhipa Instagram?
HomePage.faq12A: Kāo. Kaua rawa e whakauru i tō kupuhipa Instagram ki InstaView Stories. Kāore te taputapu e hiahia ana ki ō taipitopito takiuru Instagram, ki ngā pārongo whaiaro kore take rānei.

AboutPage.intro3: Ahakoa e hiahia ana koe ki te mātaki i ngā Stories Instagram, ki te torotoro i tētahi kōtaha whānui, ki te tirotiro i ngā Highlights Instagram, ki te kimi rānei i tētahi pānui, Reel rānei motuhake, mā InstaView Stories e whakarato tētahi huarahi māmā ki te kite i ngā ihirangi Instagram e wātea ana ki te marea.
AboutPage.storyText1: I hangaia a InstaView Stories mai i tētahi whakaaro ngāwari: kia māmā ake, kia whai hua ake hoki te torotoro i ngā ihirangi Instagram whānui.
AboutPage.storyText2: I hiahia mātou ki te hanga i tētahi papa māmā e taea ai e ngā kaiwhakamahi te whakauru i tētahi ingoa kaiwhakamahi Instagram whānui, hononga e tautokona ana rānei, kia tere kite ai i ngā Stories, kōtaha, Highlights, pānui, whakaahua, ataata, me ngā Reels e wātea ana, kaua e whai i ngā kaupae uaua.
